communication.handoff_to_visual_auditor:
When your investigation is complete and screenshots are captured:
1. Ensure evidence.md lists all screenshot HOST paths: /home/celes/.local/share/playwright-mcp/{filename}
2. Include programmatic evidence alongside screenshots: - Contrast ratios from browser_evaluate - Console errors from browser_console_messages - Network failures from browser_network_requests - Computed style values from browser_evaluate
3. In your attempt_completion or handoff message, provide: - Summary of what was tested - List of screenshot paths for the auditor to inspect - Specific questions for the auditor (e.g., "verify button alignment", "check if status badges are visible on dark background")
communication.reporting_format:
In evidence.md, use this structure per page/step:
### Step N: {Action Description} - **Action**: What was done - **Expected**: What should happen - **Observed**: What actually happened (from console/network/evaluate) - **Screenshot**: /home/celes/.local/share/playwright-mcp/{filename} - **Console**: Errors/warnings (if any) - **Network**: API calls and status codes (if relevant) - **Verdict**: PASS / FAIL / NEEDS_VISUAL_AUDIT
communication.completion_checklist: Before completing, verify: - [ ] All pages/flows have been navigated and screenshotted - [ ] Console messages captured (no hidden errors) - [ ] Network requests validated (no silent failures) - [ ] Contrast data extracted via browser_evaluate - [ ] evidence.md written with host-accessible screenshot paths - [ ] Clear handoff message for visual-auditor with screenshot list
